message.sacredarts.enrolled_hint: V / B / N / M unleash techniques. Hold C to cycle madra. Sneak + M unleashes your ultimate.
message.sacredarts.no_madra: Not enough madra — hold C to cycle.
message.sacredarts.not_enrolled: You walk no Path. Read a Foundation Manual first.
message.sacredarts.rerolled: Your old Path crumbles. The %1$s has chosen you.
path.sacredarts.endless_sword.goldsign: A silver streak marks your hair
path.sacredarts.hollow_king.goldsign: A faint crown of light hovers at your brow
path.sacredarts.sandviper.goldsign: A serpent coils around your forearm
path.sacredarts.white_fox.goldsign: Fox ears flicker at the edge of sight
screen.sacredarts.iron_body.subtitle: This choice is permanent.
screen.sacredarts.path_select.subtitle: The Path will shape your techniques. Choose well.
advancement.sacredarts.jade.hint: Reach 50 Path Mastery and cycle 5,000 madra in total
advancement.sacredarts.truegold.hint: You stand at the peak — for now
technique.sacredarts.dragons_breath.desc: A beam of black flame that ignites everything in its path. Damage grows with your level.
technique.sacredarts.burning_cloak.desc: Wreath yourself in flame: burst of speed while nearby foes catch fire.
A whirl of dragon flame around you, searing all nearby enemies.
technique.sacredarts.cinder_claws.desc: Forge claws of cinder that boost your attack power for a time.
technique.sacredarts.the_dragon_descends: Call down the dragon: a devastating explosion of black flame.
technique.sacredarts.empty_palm.desc: A palm strike of pure madra that weakens and slows the foe.
technique.sacredarts.soul_cloak.desc: Veil yourself in starlight: see in the dark and move swiftly.
technique.sacredarts.hollow_domain.desc: Project a domain that saps the strength of all within it.
technique.sacredarts.twin_barrier.desc: Twin cores resonate into a barrier of resistance and absorption.
technique.sacredarts.twin_stars_collisio: Collide your twin cores in a cataclysmic blast that launches foes skyward.
technique.sacredarts.rippling_sword.desc: Loose three spectral sword-bolts that seek your foes.
technique.sacredarts.flowing_sword.desc: Sword madra flows through you, quickening your steps.
technique.sacredarts.sword_aura_field.de: An aura of flying swords that cuts everything around you.
technique.sacredarts.hidden_sword.desc: Vanish from sight, your next strikes empowered.
technique.sacredarts.final_sword.desc: One perfect cut: massive damage that hurls enemies back.
technique.sacredarts.hollow_bolt.desc: Twin bolts of null madra that unmake what they touch.
Don the Hollow King's armor: greatly reduce incoming damage.
technique.sacredarts.still_air.desc: Still the air itself, slowing and weakening all nearby.
Crown yourself in homing spirit-stars that hunt your enemies.
technique.sacredarts.hollow_king_manifes: Manifest the Hollow King: supreme defense, a shockwave, and a storm of homing stars.
technique.sacredarts.fox_fire.desc: Spray a cone of ender-dragon fire, striking terror into those it touches.
technique.sacredarts.fox_tail.desc: Fade into fox-light: invisibility and swift movement.
technique.sacredarts.fox_dream.desc: Weave a dream that turns your enemies against each other.
technique.sacredarts.fox_mirror.desc: A mirror of illusion: vanish while blinding nearby foes.
technique.sacredarts.grand_illusion.desc: The grand illusion: plunge all around you into darkness and terror.
technique.sacredarts.venom_spit.desc: Spit two venomous bolts that poison on impact.
Move with serpent speed: swift feet and high leaps.
technique.sacredarts.miasma_cloud.desc: Conjure a lingering cloud of toxic miasma where you aim.
technique.sacredarts.venom_needles.desc: A fan of five venom-tipped needles.
technique.sacredarts.venom_tide.desc: Unleash the venom tide: poison everything around you and drown the ground in miasma.
